title: Sign in with a key
body: No password is typed here and your key never leaves this machine. The server hands you a one-time challenge, you sign it locally, and only the signature goes back.
challenge_note: Valid for two minutes and usable once. Reloading this page mints a new one.
rejected: That signature does not match any key registered to this account. Check that you signed the challenge shown above and used the key an administrator added.
no_key_title: No key is registered to this installation
no_key_body: Certificate sign-in works once an administrator adds a public key to an account. Until then, a password is the only way in.
offline_title: This browser cannot reach your Tel-Agent server
offline_body: No response from {host}. Your calls are unaffected if the machine is still running — this is a network problem between you and it. Check that you are on the business network or connected to the VPN.
